subject: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture deep-dive — slot change and prework
messages:
From: Katie Morris <katie@finexa-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Dedicated capacity architecture deep-dive — proposed week of 24 May

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the earlier conversation — the Finexa infra team is keen to do a technical architecture deep-dive on dedicated GPU capacity next week. The goal: validate pool sizing, autoscale behavior under mixed seq-length workloads, and isolation/fallback runbooks. We have a handful of engineers (platform + ML infra) who should join.

Proposed window: Tue 24 May or Thu 26 May, 60–90 minutes. Our timezone is Europe/London; happy to match US times if that works better for Redwood.

I've attached our preliminary capacity spreadsheet (finexa_capacity_requirements.xlsx) with current traffic patterns and target SLOs. Can you confirm the right Redwood owners for the session and any pre-reads or artifacts you need?

Attendees (tentative):
- Katie Morris — Platform Lead, Finexa
- Diego Alvarez — ML Infra (linked separately)
- Platform rotation engineers 1–2

Thanks — if Hannah isn't the right person to schedule, please loop in whoever owns Dedicated capacity planning.

Best,
Katie

--
Katie Morris
Platform Lead, Finexa Analytics
katie@finexa-analytics.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Katie Morris <katie@finexa-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity architecture deep-dive — proposed week of 24 May

Thanks Katie — happy to run this.

Quick notes & asks before we lock a slot:
1) Ownership: I'll coordinate the agenda and prework. Marissa will lead the architecture walkthrough; Marcus will cover autoscale and routing policies; Karthik will be on sizing and failure modes.
2) Slot options (London times):
   - Tue 24 May, 10:00–11:15 BST (15:00–16:15 CEST)
   - Tue 24 May, 14:00–15:30 BST (19:00–20:30 CEST) — if you prefer later
   - Thu 26 May, 09:00–10:30 BST
Please confirm which one works for your team and whether you need a 90-minute deep-dive or 60 minutes (I suggest 90 for runbook & Q/A).
3) Prework: we need the following from Finexa at least 48 hours before the call:
   - a short list (one slide or doc) of expected per-minute qps and peak 1-min QPS;
   - distribution of request lengths (percentiles for 16, 64, 256, 1024 token lengths);
   - examples of latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99) and any burst requirements;
   - any regulatory/isolation requirements (data residency, VPC-only, audit log retention).
4) Artifacts we'll circulate: runbook draft (redwood_dedicated-runbook-v1.3.pdf), recommended pool topologies (G:2x large / H:1x xlarge example), and a short pre-read on autoscale knobs.

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the slot and attendee list. Also, let us know if Diego should share telemetry examples (we can ask Marissa to follow up).

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity architecture deep-dive — proposed week of 24 May

+1 to Hannah's plan. I can run the architecture walkthrough and will prepare a short failover matrix showing:
- pool isolation patterns (tenant v. org-level),
- autoscale warmup vs cold-start behavior, and
- recommended fallback model mappings (quantized variants).

Scheduling note: I'm out Wed morning (24th) until 12:30 BST but available for the 14:00 slot if Finexa confirms that one. If they take the earlier 10:00 slot, Marcus can take lead on autoscale content and I'll handle the runbook Q/A later in the session.

I'll prep two short artifacts (slides + a 1-page checklist) and drop them in the Drive link Hannah shared. Marcus / Karthik — pls flag any extra data points you need from Finexa (e.g., KV cache reuse percentages, prefix reuse heuristics).

-Marissa

--

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity architecture deep-dive — proposed week of 24 May

Thanks all — 14:00 BST on Tue 24 May works best for the Finexa team (90 minutes).

Action items from Finexa (we'll deliver by Mon 22 May):
- cleaned capacity spreadsheet (I attached a trimmed copy) — finexa_capacity_requirements.xlsx;
- p50/p95/p99 SLO targets and notes on burst windows;
- confirmation whether Diego will share telemetry during the call or we should send a sample export ahead of time.

We also request one thing from Redwood: can you include a short section on operational cost levers during the walkthrough (batching strategies, quantization guidance, and cache reuse tradeoffs)? That will help our CFO and infra leads follow the session.

I've accepted the calendar invite and attached our internal network checklist for the meeting (network_checklist.txt) as a stub in the reply.

See you on Tue 24 May at 14:00 BST.

Best,
Katie
